models.name: YOLOv8n — Primary Aerial Dataset
models.description: Fine-tuned YOLOv8n detector used by the desktop app for live inference. Trained 100 epochs, AdamW, imgsz 640, batch 16 on RTX 4050.

models.name: YOLOv8n-cls — Leaf Classifier (Two-Stage)
models.description: Full-frame / per-box classifier that refines detector labels when AGRIVISION_INFER_MODE=both. Distinguishes Black Sigatoka, Bunchy Top, Panama, Moko, Yellow Sigatoka, Healthy, Not-Banana.

models.name: YOLOv8n — Primary + Secondary Datasets
models.dataset: Primary aerial set supplemented with public banana-disease datasets (see docs/SECONDARY_DATASETS.md)
models.description: Retraining run that supplements the imbalanced primary dataset with secondary sources to lift rare-class recall (panama, bunchy_top). Metrics populate automatically once its results.csv path is configured here.
